notes: Local validation fixture for S6 prior-art same-topic screening.
These controls are benchmark data, not shared idea-mining logic.
known_published controls are expected to have direct same-topic PubMed hits.
known_gap controls are synthetic near-empty controls used to estimate false apparent-gap behavior.
